payload.title: Leveraging `Xarray` for spatiotemporal diagnostics
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates the use of Xarray for calculating and visualizing global mean anomalies and spatial distributions of climate data. It utilizes CMIP6 data accessed via AWS and Google Cloud, and employs libraries such as Cartopy and Matplotlib for plotting. The notebook covers techniques like calculating anomalies, weighted means, and annualizing data, and includes methods for creating filled contour maps with custom color schemes. The outputs include time series of precipitation anomalies and spatial maps of these anomalies.
goals: Calculate global mean anomalies using Xarray.
Visualize spatial distributions with custom color schemes.
Utilize Cartopy and Matplotlib for map projections and plotting.
